svg.title: Fiber U-turn loop — right-hand bend
svg.desc: Editable, annotation-free fiber routing symbol. Two parallel horizontal arms end on the left and connect through a smooth semicircular U-turn on the right. The fiber is one continuous open path, with pale gray cladding and a blue core throughout. There is no enclosing box, outer outline or direction arrow. The geometry is schematic and does not specify a physical bend radius or delay. All artwork is native SVG on a transparent background. Cladding and core are separate Inkscape layers.
